title: USPF, UP Cebu open Cesafi volleyball campaign with wins

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) Lady Panthers and the University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons opened their campaigns with contrasting victories in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 women’s volleyball tournament. The tournament got underway during the weekend at the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Basak Campus gymnasium. The Lady Panthers, perennial Final Four contenders, made a strong statement in their season opener, sweeping the University of Cebu (UC) Lady Webmasters, 25-13, 25-20, 26-18.
